_readme: ROADMAP 2.12b. Twelve rests whose ink stands where NEITHER convention puts a rest and six the geometry says are the OTHER kind. `VERDICT_none_yet` is null on every crop and on this manifest: nothing in 2.12b has been adjudicated against the print, which is why the rule NARROWS and ABSTAINS and flips no value. A sample is a stride over the subject-sorted population, not the first N.
